title: Factor out the constant
text: $$\sqrt{4x^2-16}=2\sqrt{x^2-4}$$, so the integral is $$\frac{1}{2}$$ times the integral of $$\frac{dx}{x \sqrt{x^2-4}}$$.

title: Apply the inverse secant formula
text: With $$a=2$$, the integral of $$\frac{dx}{x \sqrt{x^2-4}}$$ is $$\frac{1}{2} \operatorname{arcsec}\left(\frac{|x|}{2}\right)$$. Multiply by $$\frac{1}{2}$$ to get $$\frac{1}{4} \operatorname{arcsec}\left(\frac{|x|}{2}\right)+C$$.
